answer_1.quote: Long-form table question answering (LFTQA) ... must understand the relationships within the data and perform human-like reasoning over the tabular content to compose the paragraph-long answer.

answer_2.quote: We examine following automatic metrics that are widely used in the LFTQA task, investigating their reliability in evaluating model performance: • BLEU ... • ROUGE ... • METEOR ... • BERTScore ... • TAPAS-Acc ... • AutoACU ... We also adopt an LLM-based evaluation system, G-Eval, to the LFTQA task.

answer_3.quote: We adopt the official prompt of evaluation instruction to assess the faithfulness and comprehensiveness of the generated answers, separately. ... We use the Llama-3.1-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-4o as the evaluators.

answer_4.quote: We tasked annotators to evaluate answers using a Likert scale ranging from 1 to 5 for the criteria of faithfulness and comprehensiveness, individually. ... We hired eight undergraduate students proficient in English. ... Each sample was independently evaluated by two different annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were trained for one hour and given a guide detailing the task execution steps; they rated each answer on faithfulness and comprehensiveness using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
